name: T1 - Content MODE reliability (40, blind, Noah+John)
instructions:
RELIABILITY ROUND (40 items). Noah and John code these SAME 40 independently, before the other 310. Noah + John Cohen's kappa on primary mode (9 classes, `unreadable` excluded) decides whether the 9-class measure stands (kappa >= 0.60) or the pre-declared 4-class collapse is used (campaign2026/validation/DECISION_RULES_content_mode_v2_2026-09-28.md). Do not compare notes until both are done. Noah: items 2, 3, 4, 6, 17, 38 (positions in this app) are ones you coded on 09-28 under the OLD v3 definitions; the loader keeps those answers separately and flags them, but please code them afresh here under codebook v4.

CODEBOOK v4 (2026-09-28). The classifier gets these exact definitions and rules. Code from the text alone; no model output is shown.

WHAT YOU CODE (per message): (1) PRIMARY mode: one of the 9 modes below, or `unreadable` (coders only, see below). (2) ALL modes present: tap every mode that is substantively present, at most 2, the primary included. (3) SPECIFICITY 0-3. (4) Notes (optional). Code from the text alone.

AXIS A - MODE (pick ONE primary; mode = HOW the message persuades, topic = WHAT it is about):
policy_specific = a concrete, checkable proposal or promise (names an instrument, sum, or deadline)
issue_position = takes a side on an issue with no concrete instrument ('за справедливые тарифы')
war_stance = СВО/front/veterans/victory as the campaign's identity; set military_bio=true if it is framed as the candidate's OWN service biography. NOT local attack/damage/compensation news (see war_frame)
values_ideas = patriotism, tradition, sovereignty, anti-West framing, history — ideas without a policy
constituency_service = casework/pork: 'добился ремонта двора', fixed a specific local thing, helped a specific person/group
valence_personal = competence, experience, endorsement by a senior figure, biography, likeability — no issue content
mobilization_generic = dates, turnout instructions, ДЭГ how-to, 'поддержите нас' with no substance
attack = negative/critical content about a NAMED opponent, party, or official — set attack_target
not_campaign = not political/campaign content at all (admin notice, unrelated repost, greeting, ad)

UNREADABLE (human coders only; the classifier has no such option). Choose primary mode `unreadable` when the text is a garbled transcript or a fragment from which you cannot tell what the message does (e.g. speech-to-text output with scrambled words, a passage cut off mid-thought). Use it sparingly: a message that is merely vague, dull or short is NOT unreadable; code it. For an `unreadable` item leave specificity blank. Unreadable items are left out of the human-agreement statistic.

DECISION RULES (verbatim from the classifier prompt):
1. `modes`: ALL modes substantively present (cap at 2, the two most central). `primary_mode`: the single most central (must be in `modes`).
2. PRIMARY MODE WHEN SEVERAL APPLY. When more than one mode is present, `primary_mode` is the mode that carries the largest share of the message's substantive content (in an attack-plus-policy message, whichever occupies more of the sentences), not the one that comes first or sounds most dramatic.
3. MODE IS HOW, TOPIC IS WHAT. Mode is HOW the message persuades; topic is WHAT it is about. Any policy domain (e.g. family support, ecology, pensions) can carry any mode: a vague direction on it («поддержим семьи», «за чистую экологию») is issue_position (specificity 1), a concrete measure on it (an instrument, sum, deadline or specific promise) is policy_specific. Being about a policy area is never by itself a reason to pick a mode; ask what the message DOES.
4. A message can be BOTH an attack and a policy claim (e.g. "Депутат X провалил ремонт школ — мы построим новую за 2 года" -> modes=["attack","policy_specific"], primary_mode judged by which carries more of the sentence).
5. constituency_service is casework/local delivery, NOT a policy proposal — keep it separate from policy_specific even though both are concrete. The test: did the candidate/party DO or PROMISE a specific local fix (service) vs propose a general rule/law/program (policy)?
6. A repost of a governor's or federal official's statement, posted without added commentary, is coded on its own content exactly as if the channel said it themselves (the panel measures the channel's output mix, not authorship) — but if the repost is bare (no framing at all, "🔻" or forwarded-tag only) and the content is itself vapid, code it mobilization_generic/not_campaign as appropriate.
7. `not_campaign` is used ONLY when nothing else applies (admin/service notice, unrelated news, pure greeting/ad).
8. GOVERNMENT DECISIONS ARE NOT PARTY POLICY. A message that RELAYS a decision, allocation, or achievement of the state (President, Government, governor, ministry, «по поручению Президента», «регион получит…», «списание долгов») without the party/candidate proposing or claiming to have secured it is NOT policy_specific. Code it valence_personal (borrowed credit / proximity to power) if the channel frames it as "our" result or stands next to it, otherwise not_campaign. Only code policy_specific/issue_position when the PARTY or CANDIDATE itself proposes, promises, demands, or claims authorship.
9. PROFESSIONAL-HOLIDAY AND CALENDAR GREETINGS («С Днём эколога!», «С Днём знаний!», «С Днём города!», «С праздником!») are not_campaign even when they praise a profession or mention the party's youth wing attending an event. They are not constituency_service (nothing was fixed or delivered) and not values_ideas unless the text makes an explicit political/values claim beyond the greeting.
10. NEWS ABOUT THE CAMPAIGN'S OWN PROCESS is not policy. A report that a forum was held, a programme is "being formed", a congress adopted a list, candidates were registered, or «мы подвели итоги» — with no concrete proposal stated in the message itself — is valence_personal (competence/organisation signalling) with specificity 0-1, NOT policy_specific 3. Specificity is scored on claims PRESENT IN THE TEXT, never on what the programme presumably contains.
11. OFFICIAL/INSTITUTIONAL NEWS RELAYS (the President nominated governor candidates; the Duma passed a law; ЦИК announced dates; a governor's schedule) are not mobilization_generic unless the message itself calls the reader to vote or gives voting instructions. Code them not_campaign (pure news relay) or valence_personal (if the channel attaches itself to the actor); topic as the content warrants (election_process for ЦИК/nomination news).
12. LOCAL WAR IMPACT IS NOT WAR-AS-IDENTITY. An alert, attack report, damage tally, evacuation, or compensation/repair message about the region itself gets war_frame=["local_security"] and its MODE by what the message does: not_campaign for a bare alert or damage report; constituency_service when the author delivers or organises concrete help (repaired homes, paid compensation, opened a shelter); policy_specific when it proposes a general rule or programme. It is war_stance ONLY if the text turns the war into the campaign's identity (heroism, "our boys", victory rhetoric).
13. PARTY ACTIVITY REPORTS. A report on a party's own events, contests, projects, meetings or forums (e.g. «Агродиктант», a «Народная программа» forum, a round table, a volunteer action) with no concrete proposal and no local delivery stated in the text is valence_personal (organisational/competence signalling), specificity 0-1. If the text states a concrete proposal, or something specific that was fixed or delivered locally, code that instead (policy_specific / constituency_service).
14. PARTY-AS-PROVIDER ASSOCIATION. A party's name or ballot number attached to a local event, fair, festival, or lifestyle/community content (e.g. «… — номер N в бюллетене» beside a regional fair), where nothing is fixed, delivered or proposed, is valence_personal (the party presents itself as a presence in local life). It is not constituency_service (nothing was fixed or delivered) and not policy. If something concrete WAS delivered or fixed, constituency_service applies.
15. VAGUE VISION PLUS CALL TO VOTE. A vague vision or aspiration together with a call to vote («Мы хотим страну, где ценят труд и порядок. Голосуйте за нас») is values_ideas if a vision or values claim is stated; mobilization_generic only if the message is essentially 'go vote / vote for us' with no vision or values content.

AXIS B - SPECIFICITY (0-3):
  0 = none: no substantive claim at all (pure mobilization/greeting/attack-with-no-content)
  1 = vague direction: names a value or direction with no concrete proposal ("нужно поддержать семьи")
  2 = concrete but unquantified: a specific proposal/action with no number or deadline ("построим детскую площадку во дворе")
  3 = quantified with an instrument or deadline: a law, sum, percentage, or date attached ("снизим тариф на 15% с 1 января", "внесём закон об индексации пенсий на уровень инфляции")
Score the MOST specific substantive claim in the message. A message with primary_mode=not_campaign or mobilization_generic and no substantive claim is specificity=0.

NOTES FOR CODERS ON PROMPT-ONLY ELEMENTS. The classifier prompt also asks for military_bio, war_frame and attack_target. Humans do NOT code those in this round; where a rule or a mode definition below mentions them (war_stance, LOCAL WAR IMPACT), apply only the MODE part of the rule.

WORKED EXAMPLES (the classifier's own; mode and specificity only):
Text: "Мы внесём в Госдуму законопроект об индексации пенсий работающим пенсионерам на уровень фактической инфляции с 1 января 2027 года."
  -> primary_mode=policy_specific; modes=policy_specific; specificity=3. quantified (instrument=law, deadline=1 Jan 2027) — the top specificity anchor.
Text: "Мы за справедливые тарифы ЖКХ для всех регионов страны."
  -> primary_mode=issue_position; modes=issue_position; specificity=1. a side taken, no instrument -> issue_position, specificity 1 (vague direction).
Text: "Депутат нашей фракции добился ремонта дороги на улице Ленина и установки новых лавочек во дворе дома 14."
  -> primary_mode=constituency_service; modes=constituency_service; specificity=2. concrete, delivered, named place — but casework, not a general policy -> constituency_service NOT policy_specific. Specificity 2 (no number/deadline beyond the fact of delivery).
Text: "В нашем избирательном округе мы построим новую детскую поликлинику — современную, с полным набором специалистов."
  -> primary_mode=policy_specific; modes=policy_specific; specificity=2. a PROMISE of a general facility (not yet delivered, not a personal favor) -> policy_specific; no number/deadline -> specificity 2. Contrast with ex3: delivered casework for a named person/place = service; a general facility promise = policy.
Text: "Наш кандидат — ветеран СВО, прошёл фронт, знает цену Победы. Теперь он будет защищать интересы округа так же, как защищал Родину."
  -> primary_mode=war_stance; modes=war_stance|valence_personal; specificity=1. war as the candidate's own biography -> military_bio=true; also valence (competence-by-service) but war_stance is the sentence's core.
Text: "Помним подвиг наших дедов. Победа деда — это и моя Победа. Патриотизм — это не лозунг, а образ жизни."
  -> primary_mode=values_ideas; modes=values_ideas; specificity=0. history/memory framing with no policy or personal-service claim -> values_ideas, not war_stance (no current front/mobilization content) or svo_war topic.
Text: "Своих не бросаем: продолжаем гуманитарную помощь бойцам на передовой и их семьям. Отправили очередную партию медикаментов и техники."
  -> primary_mode=war_stance; modes=war_stance; specificity=2. concrete action (medical supplies shipment) but framed as war-identity content, not a general "policy" proposal -> war_stance stays primary; specificity 2 for the concrete-but-unquantified delivery.
Text: "Уже 20 сентября! Приходите на избирательные участки и голосуйте за нашу команду. Каждый голос важен!"
  -> primary_mode=mobilization_generic; modes=mobilization_generic; specificity=0. calls to vote with no substance -> mobilization_generic + election_process topic (do not confuse with mode-C 'not vapid' cases below).
Text: "Электронное голосование (ДЭГ) пройдёт 18-20 сентября. Подать заявление можно на портале госуслуг до 11 сентября включительно."
  -> primary_mode=mobilization_generic; modes=mobilization_generic; specificity=2. election LOGISTICS, not a vapid "vote for us" slogan — still mode mobilization_generic (it is not campaign advocacy content) but topic election_process and specificity can be >0 for concrete procedural detail. Mode and specificity are independent of whether the content is procedural vs slogan-vapid.
Text: "Наш кандидат Иванов — опытный хозяйственник, 15 лет руководил заводом, знает жизнь округа не понаслышке."
  -> primary_mode=valence_personal; modes=valence_personal; specificity=1. pure competence/biography claim, no issue content -> valence_personal; topic=other since no substantive issue is touched.
Text: "Пока действующий депутат Петров годами обещал новую поликлинику, ничего не построено. Хватит пустых слов — мы построим её за 2 года."
  -> primary_mode=attack; modes=attack|policy_specific; specificity=2. a named attack PLUS a concrete counter-promise -> both modes coded; primary is attack here because the criticism occupies the larger share of the message's substantive content. (Per PRIMARY MODE WHEN SEVERAL APPLY: if the promise occupied more of the message, primary_mode would be policy_specific.)
Text: "Власти снова задержали нашего активиста и признали движение иноагентом. Это политическое давление перед выборами."
  -> primary_mode=attack; modes=attack|issue_position; specificity=1. attack on unnamed collective authorities still counts (attack_target can be a role/institution, not only a personal name).
Text: "Поздравляем всех с Днём города! Хорошего праздника и отличного настроения 🎉"
  -> primary_mode=not_campaign; modes=not_campaign; specificity=0. 
Text: "⚡️ Области спишут часть задолженности по бюджетным кредитам. Решение принято по поручению Президента. Высвобожденные средства направят на ЖКХ и общественный транспорт."
  -> primary_mode=not_campaign; modes=not_campaign; specificity=0. a STATE decision relayed by a party organ with no party claim of authorship -> not policy_specific. (If the text said «по инициативе Единой России» or «наш депутат добился», it would be policy_specific or constituency_service.) Topics still coded on content.
Text: "💚 Региональное отделение поздравляет всех специалистов в области охраны окружающей среды с Днём эколога! Благодаря вашему труду сохраняются леса и чистый воздух нашего края."
  -> primary_mode=not_campaign; modes=not_campaign; specificity=0. calendar greeting: nothing delivered, nothing proposed -> not constituency_service, not values_ideas.
Text: "«Есть результат!»: партия подвела итоги работы и начала формирование новой Народной программы. Главная задача — выработать предложения для нового программного документа."
  -> primary_mode=valence_personal; modes=valence_personal; specificity=1. process news about the programme, no proposal stated in the text -> valence (organisational competence), specificity 1 at most. NEVER specificity 3 for a programme that is only named.
Text: "🇷🇺 Президент представил Парламенту республики кандидатуры для избрания на должность Главы региона: Темрезов, Иванов, Петров."
  -> primary_mode=not_campaign; modes=not_campaign; specificity=0. institutional news relay with no call to vote -> not mobilization_generic; topic election_process.
Text: "Депутат встретился с губернатором на открытии новой школы в райцентре и обсудил перспективы развития региона."
  -> primary_mode=valence_personal; modes=valence_personal; specificity=0. a governor-adjacent photo-op repost, no added framing and no substantive claim -> valence (proximity to power), specificity 0, not policy.
Text: "В результате атаки БПЛА на Шебекинский округ повреждены два частных дома и автомобиль. Пострадавших нет. Оперативные службы работают на месте."
  -> primary_mode=not_campaign; modes=not_campaign; specificity=0. a bare local attack/damage report -> not_campaign, war_frame local_security. NOT war_stance: nothing turns the war into identity.
Text: "Всем жителям, чьё жильё пострадало от обстрелов, выплатим компенсацию до 1 октября. Уже восстановили 140 домов в приграничье, работу продолжаем."
  -> primary_mode=constituency_service; modes=constituency_service; specificity=3. delivered, quantified help for war damage at home -> constituency_service with local_security; specificity 3 (number + deadline).
Text: "Вручил ордена Мужества семьям наших земляков, погибших в зоне СВО. Их подвиг — пример для всех нас. Герои не умирают."
  -> primary_mode=war_stance; modes=war_stance; specificity=0. honouring fallen fighters as heroes -> military_identity; war_stance because the war is the message's value core. military_bio false: not the author's own service.
Text: "Подписал постановление: участники СВО и члены их семей получат бесплатное зачисление детей в детские сады и приоритет при трудоустройстве в областные учреждения."
  -> primary_mode=policy_specific; modes=policy_specific; specificity=2. a general rule benefiting veterans and families -> policy_specific with front_support (the author claims authorship: «подписал»).

validation.label: All modes present (tap; at most 2, the primary included; blank = primary only)
